description:
Company Description

Join a multibillion-dollar global company that brings together amazing technology, people, and operational scale to become a powerhouse in the memory industry. Headquartered in Rancho Cordova, California, Solidigm combines elements of an established, successful technology company with the spirit, agility, and entrepreneurial mindset of a start-up. In addition to the U.S. headquarters and other facilities in the U.S., the company has international presence in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Solidigm will continue to lead the world in innovating new Memory technologies with aspirations to be the #1 NAND memory company in the world. At Solidigm, we view problems as opportunities to define innovative solutions that hold the power to change the world and unleash the potential technological needs that the future holds. At Solidigm, we are One Team that fosters a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture that embraces individual uniqueness and empowers us to bring our best selves to deliver excellence in support of Solidigm's vision and mission to be the go-to partner for optimized data storage solutions. You can be part of the takeoff of an innovative business that develops cutting-edge products, delivers strong business value for customers, provides an engaging workplace for its employees, and serves a greater impact on the world. This is a golden opportunity for the right applicant to join us and help design, build, and lead Solidigm. We want a diverse team of dedicated professionals who will not just be Solidigm team members but contribute to how we shape the future of the organization. We are seeking applicants who will grow and thrive in our culture; be customer inspired, trusting, innovative, team-oriented, inclusive, results driven, collaborative, passionate, and flexible.







Job Description

We are seeking a graduate-level intern to join our Talent Acquisition (TA) team as a Talent Acquisition Data Engineering & Analytics Intern. This role is designed for a highly motivated individual who wants hands-on experience building and analyzing TA metrics that influence business decisions at a global scale. The intern will learn how to extract, transform, and visualize data from multiple HR and business systems while contributing to the foundation of our global TA reporting function.




The Talent Acquisition Data Engineering & Analytics Intern will help build the foundation for Talent Acquisition reporting and analytics. This internship is designed for a technically strong graduate student interested in applying data engineering, analytics, and visualization techniques to real-world recruiting and workforce challenges.




During the internship, the intern will analyze recruiting workflows, explore recruiting datasets, and develop prototype dashboards that support recruiting operations and leadership decision-making.

The intern will work directly with Talent Acquisition leadership and will have the opportunity to influence how recruiting performance is measured and reported across the organization. In addition, the intern will collaborate with teams responsible for systems such as SmartRecruiters, Workday, Jira, and ServiceNow to understand how recruiting data is generated and how it can be structured for reporting and analytics.




This internship focuses on data exploration, metrics development, and dashboard prototyping, rather than operational recruiting activities.




What You Will Work On

During the internship, you will contribute to a project focused on building the foundation for Talent Acquisition analytics dashboards. Key project areas may include:




Recruiting Data Discovery

Analyze the end-to-end recruiting workflow and identify where data is captured across systems
Study the SmartRecruiters data structure and understand key recruiting entities
Identify key data sources across the recruiting ecosystem including ATS, HRIS, and operational tools




Talent Acquisition Metrics Framework

Help define key recruiting metrics and analytics used to measure hiring performance
Document standardized definitions for recruiting metrics such as time-to-fill, funnel conversion rates, and offer acceptance
Develop a Talent Acquisition data dictionary




Data Modeling & Data Preparation

Develop a conceptual data model that supports recruiting analytics
Use SQL or Python to explore and analyze recruiting datasets
Prepare structured datasets that can support dashboard reporting




Dashboard Development

Develop prototype recruiting dashboards using Power BI
Create visualizations that support recruiting operations and leadership reporting
Translate business questions into measurable analytics metrics




Documentation & Analytics Framework

Document the recruiting data ecosystem and data flows across systems
Produce implementation-ready documentation including:
data model diagrams
dashboard specifications
recommended data architecture approach
Learn and practice data visualization and storytelling by preparing dashboards and reports for TA and HR leadership.




Example Internship Deliverables

Talent Acquisition Data Ecosystem Overview
Recruiting Metrics Framework
TA Data Dictionary
Conceptual Data Model for Recruiting Analytics
Prototype Power BI Dashboard
Documentation supporting future TA analytics development







Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Graduate degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science
Experience and proficiency with SQL, Python, R, or similar tools for data extraction and transformation
Proficient building data visualizations with Power BI
Familiarity with ETL/ETL pipelines
Data modeling and dataset design

Preferred Qualifications

Passion for HR and Talent Acquisition analytics, and how data informs business strategy.
Familiarity with AI / Machine Learning techniques
Experience working with APIs or data integrations
Experience working with large datasets, APIs, or cloud-based data environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Interest in workforce analytics, business operations analytics, or HR technology







Additional Information

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.
This role is eligible to work remote with a strong preference for the candidate to work on Pacific, Mountain or Central Time Zones.
The compensation for this role is $35 /hour.
